headline: Blanked, but with chances
record_line: Yesterday: 0-4 on the top plays · Season: 44-191

entries.headline: Matt Olson stayed in the yard
entries.story: Matt Olson went 2-for-4 against Kevin Gausman and the Chicago Cubs. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Will Smith did not appear
entries.story: Will Smith was scratched or never got in the game, so the pick carries over as a no-action.

entries.headline: Carter Jensen came close
entries.story: Carter Jensen went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Hunter Brown and the Houston Astros. Closest call was a double in the 5th: "Carter Jensen doubles (32) on a fly ball to left fielder LaMonte Wade Jr. Isaac Collins scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Juan Soto stayed in the yard
entries.story: Juan Soto went 2-for-5 with 1 BB and 1 RBI against Shane Baz and the Baltimore Orioles. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Freddie Freeman stayed in the yard
entries.story: Freddie Freeman went 3-for-5 against Rhett Lowder and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front.
